tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phyag rgya chen po'i bsdus don gser gyi lde mig ces bya ba 'jigs bral dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi

khrid yig bzhugs so// "$ ༄༅// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ bla ma yi dam lha dang ḍā ki'i tshogs// dkon mchog gsum la gus pas rab 'dud de// phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa yi// bsdus don mi brjed zur du bkod pa'o// phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa 'di la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro la brgyad/ thun mong pa drug thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ rje rgod tshang pa'i khrid yig tu shes par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos so// dang po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po nas rdo rje'i snying po la gsungs/ des tai lo shes rab bzang po la gsungs/ des mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsungs/ des sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā la/ des dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la/ des dwags sgom zla 'od gzhon nu la/ des mtha' rtsa pa phag mo gru pa la/ des 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras la gsungs/ des rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje la/ des yang dgon pa chos nyid rgya mtsho la/ des thugs sras spyan lnga'i rin ldan la/ des kun mkhyen zur phug chos rje la/ des bya btang ri khrod ras chen la/ des sman sgom 'od zer seng ldeng la/ des la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ des 'dul 'dzin ngag gi dbang po la/ des stag lung ngag dbang grags pa la/ des mnyam med shwa ra ba rab 'byams la/ des rjes btsun gtsang smyon pa la/ des rgod tshang ras chen la/ des 'dren mchog byams pa phun tshogs la/ des 'jigs bral dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ des byams pa rgyal mtshan bkra shis la/ des rtsa ba'i bla ma la'o// gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos ni/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa zhes pa'i don la rkang bzhi ste/ dang po sems kyi rtsad bcad pa/ gnyis pa sems gyi bzhag thabs bstan pa/ gsum pa sems gol sa bstan pa/

bzhi pa sems lam khyer bstan pa dang bzhi'o// dang po sems kyi bzhi rtsad bcad pa la'ang man ngag ltar bcad pa/ 'grel pa ltar bcad pa/ gzhung lugs ltar bcad pa gsum mo// dang po la lus gnad dang sems gnad gnyis/ dang po lus rnam snang gi chos bdun te/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung byas pas drod shugs la skye/ lag pa mnyam bzhag dam du byas pas rtsa kha 'byed cing bde ba skye/ sgal tshigs mda' ltar bsrangs pas rlung gnad du tshud/ os mgos ol mdud mnan pas rba rlabs kyi rtsa gnyis non/ lce rtse yar rkan la sbyar bas snying rtse gyen la ldog pas mi rtog pa rgyud la skye/ dpung mgo rgod gshog ltar brgyangs pas rlung nad chung*/ mig sna rtse la phab pas mig mi 'gul bas dmigs pa gsal ba yin no// de ltar lus gnad bdun po li khri ltar gcun pas rtsa rlung thig le rang bzhin gyis chun nas sems 'od gsal du gnas pa yin no// de ltar lus gnad drang por ma bsrang par mgo bo bkug na tshigs pa za/ dmigs pa mi gsal/ gnyid che/ khams nyob/ ro stod sgyed na shes pa 'phyo/ rtog pa 'phro zhing rgod/ stod gzer zhing ro stod sgur na/ shug ring 'byin/ chung ngu nyams mi dga'/ che ru snying rlung 'jug stod brgyang nas na/ g.yas su yo na dmigs pa mi zin/ 'gro snying 'dod/ nor la gzan/ g.yon du yo na 'dod sred che/ tshe thung*/ 'khor mi 'du/ don mi 'grub/ 'tshang ra gdan du sting na thig le 'dzag mkhal nad 'jug le lo che/ nyams ngan no// de ltar lus sdod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi skyon shes par byas nas/ lus gnad la gnas pa dang drang ba shin tu gal che'o// de ltar lus gnad dang bstun ma shes na skyon ni/ sam bhu tri las/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gi ni don go yang*// lus kyi de nyid ma shes pas// de dag thams cad 'bras bu med// ces so// phan yon ni/ chu shing snying po med pa la// snying po'i 'bras bu ro ldan zhing*// de bzhin snying po med lus la// bde ba'i 'bras bu dngos grub gnas// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa sems kyi gnad ni/

'das pa'i rjes mi dpyod/ 'das pa'i rjes dpyad na 'gyod zhen gyi phyir snyag yin/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ ma 'ongs pa'i sngon bsus na re dogs kyi bsam rgya yin/ da lta ba yid la mi byed/ da lta ba yid la byas na chags sdang gi yo lang yin pas/ mtha' dbus dang ngos bzung med par nam mkha' ltar mnyam par bzhag gnas dang rten med par bar snang gi sprin lta bur mnyam par bzhag rgyun chad med par chu bo bzhin du mnyam par bzhag rin po che las grub pa'i lha sku bzhin sgo gsum g.yo ba med par mnyam par bzhag bsnyems dang rtog pa med par dur khrod kyi ro ltar mnyam par bzhag 'pho 'gyur dang g.yo 'gul med par ri rgyal lhun po ltar mnyam par bzhag ltag chu chad pa'i rang 'thag bzhin sgo gsum las med du mnyam par bzhag 'khor lo lnga ldan blta bar bya// rgyus sha tshil chu rgyal mo yin// ye shes lnga po rtogs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa 'grel pa ltar dpyad pa ni/ sngon 'byung ba 'das pa'i dus na thag pa sbrul du mthong ba'i rtog dpyod dang 'brel bar/ gtsang smyon dran rgya ring mo'i bstan bcos las/ 'di la sbrul skyon bsal bya med// thag skyon bzhag pa cung zad med// thag pa rang la thag par blta// thag par mthong na sbrul 'jigs grol// zhes pa dang*/ de'i don a jo byams pa mgon po'i man ngag rgyan las/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes so// sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na sgyed rdo gser du gyur pa'i rtog dpyod dang 'brel par/ gtsang smyon nyams dga' a li ma'i mdo las/ 'di la gang yang 'asgyed rdo gser du 'gyur med la// bza' tsho gnyis sam sgyed rdo'i rgyu ni rang ngo shes// de'i don a pha rdzogs shag gis// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud pa las/ de la gang yang nyon mongs rnam par 'gyur med pa// byang chub sems dpa' shes rab pha rol phyin pas rtogs// zhes gsungs so// sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na rang gi bu chen por gyur pa'i rtog dpyod dang 'brel par/

gtsang smyon gnas lugs gcer mthong gi rgyud las/ 'di nyid dgra bo zhes bya ste// 'di nyid gnyen gyi dam pa'o// dgra bo bsad nas gzhan du ni// gnyen gyi dam pa 'phrad mi 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ de'i don mes po rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud brtag gnyis las/ 'di nyid 'khor ba zhes bya ste// 'di nyid mya ngan 'das pa thob// 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur// ces gsungs so// yang gnas lugs gcer mthong gi rgyud las/ rang gi bu yis nor 'tshol dang*// la kha'i a ra jag pa gnyis// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// ces de'i don brtag gnyis las/ rnam rtog ye shes snying po can// 'khor ba'i rnam par rtog pa la// khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa gzhung lugs ltar dpyad pa ni/ sems nyid 'di dang po gang nas byung*/ bar du gang na gnas/ tha ma gar 'gro brtag pas/ dang po byung sa med/ rgyu dang rkyen las ma byung pas ye nas rtsa bral du 'dug bar du gnas pa med de dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pas/ 'gyu ba stong rgyu dang snang ba stong snang du 'dug tha ma 'gro sa med de 'dir song gi yul dang rjes med pas/ 'gyu ba rang grol dang snang ba rang dngos su 'dug des na sems nyid 'di dang po rgyus ma bskyed pas tha ma rkyen gyis mi 'jig dus glo bur du mi 'byung bas gang stong dang 'phel 'grib med/ snang srid kun la khyab pas phyogs dang ris su ma chad/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pas 'di zhes mtshon du med/ gang du'ang ma grub la cir yang snang ba yod med rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' las 'das/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med cing rang bzhin ye nas dag pas 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos te sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin no// gsungs so// gnyis pa sems nyid bzhag thabs bstan pa ni/ sems mi gnas pa gnas par byed pa'i thabs la drug ste/

khyung chen nam mkha' la lding pa bzhin du ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du rig pa rtsol sgrub med par mnyam par bzhag rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba bzhin du sems nyid g.yo 'gul med par mnyam par bzhag nyi zla sprin dang bral ba bzhin du kun gsal mdangs dang ldan par mnyam par bzhag bu chung lha khang la blta ba bzhin du gsal cha ma 'gags pa la 'dzin cha med par mnyam par bzhag chu las chu bur byung ba bzhin du byung tshor thams cad sems su shes par byas la mnyam par bzhag bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin du rig pa rjes med du mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa sems kyi gol sa bcad pa ni/ yar sangs rgyas la re na gol bas/ rang sems rang gis rig pa las gud na bzang po'i sangs rgyas gcig med par kho thag bcad/ mar 'khor ba la dogs na gol bas rang sems rang gis rig pa las gud na ngan ngan po'i 'khor ba cig med par kho thag bcad/ phyi'i snang ba la zhen na gol bas cir snang thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma ru kho thag bcad/ nang gi nyams myong la zhen na gol bas phyag rgya chen po yid la byed pa med par kho thag bcad/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad na gol bas rnam rtog ma zad kyi bar du las rgyu 'bras kyis mi bslu bar kho thag bcad la/ sdig pa'i las phra mo nas spang la dge ba'i las phra mo nas bsgrub bo// bzhi pa sems kyi lam khyer bstan pa ni/ spyod lam rgyun du khyer ba'i rnal 'byor la drug ste/ nyin par snang ba rgya'i rnal 'byor/ nang nub 'dod yon grogs su khyer ba'i rnal 'byor/ srod la dbang po gzhi la bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor/ nam gung shes bya bum par bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor/ tho rangs rig pa gsal gdab pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'chi khar ye shes zang thal du btang ba'i rnal 'byor dang drug go /dang po ni/ 'di ltar gyi snang ba thams cad rang sems 'khrul par rgyas gdab/ 'khrul ba la rang bzhin med pas rmi lam sgyu mar rgyas gdab/ sgyu ma la ngos bzung med pas chos thams cad zag med du rgyas gdab pa'o// gnyis pa ni/

'dod yon thams cad rab stong pa la stong pa'i tshul gyis rol/ chos nyid la chos nyid thim pa'i tshul du longs spyod/ 'bring sgyu ma la sgyu mar rol/ ye shes la ye shes thim pa'i tshul gyis longs spyod/ tha ma bla ma dang yi dam la mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshul gyis longs spyod do// gsum pa ni/ 'di ltar rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i dran pa gang shar gyi ngo bo la ce re bltas pas/ rtog pa thams cad gzhi chos nyid kyi ngang du 'du ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang gi snying khar bla ma dam pa bsgom la de la shes pa ma yengs par gtad nas gnyid log pas/ gnyid 'od gsal du 'char bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa ni/ dus gnad shes rab kyi rgya khral la chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad la gzhig 'grol btang ste/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams rim par gsal btab pa'o// drug pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa nam 'chi ba'i tshe phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad la zhen chags rtsa ba nas bcad nas/ don dam par sems la skye 'chi med pas/ phyag rgya chen po yid la byar med par kho thag bcad la/ sgom med kyi ngang du dran pa yengs med du bzhag pas/ bar do med par ye shes zang thal du sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro// gzhi rtsa bcad pa lta ba yin// bzhag thabs bstan pa sgom pa yin// lam khyer bstan pa spyod pa yin// gol sa bcad pa 'bras bu yin// go bar sla la 'khyer bde ba// yi ge bzhi pa'i gdams pa yin// de'i don gtan la 'bad par byed pa la/ sems kyi mtshan nyid/ ming gi rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ zhi lhag zung 'brel bsgom tshul/ dran pa brten tshul/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa/ gol sa skyon gyis sel thabs/ dbye ba dang brgyad do// dang po sems kyi mtshan nyid ni/ sems gsal rig stong gsum/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong par 'dod cing*/ phung po rnam dpyod kyis chags sdang 'gags/ de yang gsal ba sems kyi ting nge 'dzin/

stong pa sems kyi ngo bo/ rig pa sems kyi mtshan nyid yin/ gsal ba sems kyi rang bzhin yin te/ mdo brgyad stong pa las/ sems la sems ma mchis te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// zhes dang*/ stong pa sems kyi ngo bo ste/ gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ mthong rgyu ci yang med pa ste// yang dag par ni mthong ba yin// zhes pa dang*/ mdo sdud pa las/ gzugs rnam mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing*// 'du shes mthong ba med la sems pa'ang mthong ba med// gang la rnam par shes dang sems yid ma mthong ba// 'di ni chos mthong yin zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// mthong ba dpe gzhan gyis ni snyed par nus ma yin// nam mkha' mthong zhes sems can tshig tu rab brjod kyang*// nam mkha' ji ltar mthong ba'i don de shes par gyis// de ltar chos mthong pa yang 'dren pas rab tu bsngags// zhes gsungs so// rig pa sems kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ sems kyi mtshan nyid rig cing gsal// dri mas ma gos ye nas dag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang du'ang ma grub la cir yang 'char ba/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa de sems kyi ngo bo yin te/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de'i ngo bor gnas pa'i phyir ro// sam bhu tra las/ phung po rnam dpyod stong pa nyid// chu shing bzhin du snying po med// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// stong nyid de dang 'dra ma yin// zhes dang*/ mdo las/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba// de la thams cad rung ba yin// gang la stong nyid mi rung ba// de la thams cad rung ma yin// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa lhas/ gang phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa yin no// de phyir rten 'byung ma yin pa'i// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ming gi rnam grangs ni/ sems/ rig stong*/ chos dbyings// gnas lugs/

mthar thug byang chub kyi sems/ tha mal gyi shes pa/ phyag rgya chen po/ smra bsam brjod med rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin no// gsum pa dbye ba ni/ sems tha dad pa'i dbye ba ni med la/ sems kyi 'char sgo la dbye bar byas na ni tshad las 'das so// bzhi pa zhi lhag bsgom tshul la/ zhi gnas bsgom tshul/ lhag mthong bsgom tshul/ zhi lhag zung 'brel du bsgom tshul dang gsum mo// dang po la/ nges tshig ngo bo/ dbye ba/ bying rmugs gnyis dang 'phro rgod gnyis byung tshul/ de sel thabs bstan pa dang lnga'o// dang po ni/ phra rags kyi rtog pa thams cad zhi nas/ mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas pa tsam mo// gnyis pa/ gsal dwangs 'dzin med kyi ngang la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa de zhi gnas kyi ngo bo yin no// de la yang gsum ste/ rig thog gi zhi gnas/ rtog thog gi zhi gnas/ snang thog gi zhi gnas so// dang po ni/ phra rags kyi rtog pa kun gzhi'i ngang du zhi nas/ 'dzin med du seng nge gnas pa de rig thog gi zhi gnas so// rtog pa gang shar gyi ngo bo la cer gyis bltas pas gtad med du zhi gnas/ stong par thal le song ba'i ngang la lhan ne gnas pa de rtog thog gi zhi gnas yin no// sgo lnga'i yul du snang ba gang shar gyi ngo bo la ce re bltas pas/ 'dzin med du zing nger zhig nas/ stong cha le ba la gnas pa de snang thog gi zhi gnas yin no// rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/ bu dge bsnyen skyab mchog tshur la nyon// lus gnad mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus// rtog med snang ba 'gags pa de// zhi gnas lteng po bya ba yin// de dran shes kyis ngar 'don byas pa'i tshe// mar me ltar rang gsal lhag ge ba// me tog ltar rang mdangs sa le ba// mig nam mkha' dwangs par bltas pa bzhin// rig stong rjen ne yer re ba// rtog med gsal zhing dwangs pa de// zhi gnas nyams kyi snang ba yin// zhes pa dang*/

rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa la skyon du mi blta zhing*// mi rtog pa ched du mi gnyer par// sems rang lugs su zhog la rgyangs so zhig tshug dang*// sgom zhi gnas kyi mthil du phebs pa zhig 'ong gi /zhes gsungs so// zhi gnas kyi yon tan rnams skye bar byed pa la/ ring ba'i rgyu ni tshul khrims bsrungs shing tshe 'di blos btang ba dang dben pa bsten pa yin/ nye rgyu ni bskyed rim bsgom pa yin no// gsum pa dbye ba ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas gnyis su yod de/ sa mtshams nges 'byung gis 'byed do// bzhi pa ni/ sems kyi dwangs cha'am dmigs rten dang mi ldan pa'i ngang la gnas pa de bying ba bya ba yin/ gsal cha dang mi ldan par rtog med du snang ba 'gags par gnas pa ni rmugs pa bya ba yin/ sems rang rig rang gsal du mi gnas par 'phro la 'phro ba zer/ 'phro ba je rag tu song ba de la rgod pa zer ba yin no// lnga pa de sel thabs bstan pa ni/ bying rmugs gnyis sel thabs ni/ rig pa la ngar 'don pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yin/ 'phro rgod gnyis sel thabs ni/ dbugs dbyung rngub la btang len dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa yin no// gnyis pa lhag mthong bsgom tshul la/ nges tshig ngo bo/ dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa las lhag cing gnyis med kyi ye shes mthong bas na lhag mthong zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rtog dpyod kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas sems kyi gnas tshul/ yin lugs ltar gtan la pheb pa'i so sor rtog pa'i shes rab de lhag mthong gi ngo bo yin te/ de la'ang gsum yod de/ rig thog gi zhi gnas de rang zhal la ce re bltas pas/ rang ngo bo blo 'das su rjen yer gyis 'char ba/ de rig thog gi lhag mthong*/ gong gi zhi gnas de'i ngang nas rtog pa cig thol gyis skyes pa na/ de la rang zhal la ce re bltas pas/

rtog pa de 'gags rgyu'am yal rgyu med par rtog pa dang sems kyi ngo bo dbyer med blo 'das su rjen yer gyis 'char ba de/ rtog thog gi lhag mthong yin/ snang thog gi zhi gnas de'i snang zhal la ce re bltas pas snang sems blo 'das dbyer med du rjen yer gyis 'char ba de/ snang thog gi lhag mthong ste/ mi la ras pas/ nyams snang ba de rnams gzhir bzhag nas// rje dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs bzhin du// chos thos bsam gyis phu thag bcad nas ni// bdag med go yul gyi sor rtog lhag mthong la// zhi gnas ngar 'don gyi srog thag bzang po btags// byams snying rje yi skyes bu stobs ldan gyis// gzhan phan sems bskyed kyi stobs rtsal drag po bskyed// smon lam rnam dag gis gyen du drangs pa las// mthong lam rnam par mi rtog mngon sum du// rnam dag mthong med kyi lhag mthong rtogs te mchi// blo re dogs kyi rang 'tshang de dus rig /ma phyin par sangs rgyas kyi sa ru slebs// ma bltas par chos sku de dus mthong*// ma bsgrub par 'dun ma lhun gyis grub// bu dge bsnyen sems la de ltar zhog /ces dang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ sems ngos bzung med pa stong pa'i dbyings// 'gags med du 'char ba rig pa'i gshis// blo bral gyi gsal stong rjen pa 'di// rang so ru zhog la rang zhal la ltos dang*// sgom lhag mthong gi rang zhal mthong ba gcig 'ong gis// zhes gsungs/ lhag mthong gi yon tan rnams skye bar byed pa la/ ring rgyu dang nye rgyu gnyis/ dang po ni/ thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab bo// gnyis pa ni/ spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim mo// lhag mthong la dbye na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lhag mthong gnyis su yod de// sa mtshams ni nges 'byung gis dbye ba'o// gsum pa zhi lhag zung 'brel du bsgom tshul la/ nges tshig ngo bo/ dbye ba/ yon tan no// dang po ni/

gnas 'gyu'i nyams rtogs zung du 'brel bas zung 'brel zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams su blangs pas mthar thug ye shes de gang snang yul med du gsal ba'i ngang nas/ snang ba rang sar don byed nus pa de snang thog gi zhi lhag zung 'brel yin te/ rje btsun mi la ras pas/ yod pa dngos por snang ba dang*// med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis// ngo bo dbyer med ro gcig pas// rang rig gzhan rig yod min te// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis// rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong*// chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong*// de las snying rje shugs 'byung ste/ stobs dang mi 'jigs gzungs la sogs// nor bu rin chen tshul du 'byung*// de rnal 'byor nga yi rtogs tshad yin// zhes dang*/ 'bri gung dgongs gcig las/ mnyam bzhag la yon tan thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ stong nyid rtogs na stong nyid rgyu 'bras bu 'char/ bya ba dang*/ sems can tha dad pa'i bab snang ba yang tha dad pa/ zhes dang*/ yang dgon pas/ blo rtog pa ru 'gyu ba gnas lugs kyi sgo/ rang ngo shes pa 'di nyams len gyi gnad/ rang zhal dang mjal bas ngang du 'dres/ rang min gyi rtogs pa gcig 'dug gam ltos dang*/ sgom gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba cig 'ong gis/ ces dang*/ zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin de skye bar byed pa la/ ring rgyu dang nye rgyu gnyis yod pas/ dang po ni/ zhi lhag gnyis bsgom pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mthong zhing gsal/ yengs med du gsol ba 'debs pa'o// gsum pa dbye ba/ theg pa che chung gi zhi lhag zung 'brel gnyis su yod de/ sa mtshams ni kun rdzob byang sems kyis 'byed pa yin no// bzhi pa yon tan ni/ mnyam bzhag khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa gcig dgos te/ khyad chos bzhi ni/ gsal ba dang*/ dwangs pa dang*/

phra ba dang*/ mi rtog pa'o// gsal ba ni/ yul med du rang gsal ba ste dper na mar me rang gsal ba lta bu'o// dwangs pa ni/ gsal ba de'i ngang nas sems kyi grung cha'am/ dwangs cha ston dus tho rangs kyi nam mkha' lta bu'o// phra ba ni/ gsal dwangs kyi ngar cha ma shor ba'i ngang nas rtog dpyod kyi 'dzin pa med par/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis gsung rab kyi spu ris rtog med du 'byed pa'o// mi rtog pa la'ang gsum ste ngan rtog dang bral ba/ bzang rtog dang bral/ lung ma bstan dang bral ba'o// dang po ni/ rnam rtog 'gyu ba chad pa'o// gnyis pa bsgom bya sgom byed kyi 'dzin pa bral ba'o// gsum pa ni yul med du rang ngo shes pa'o// de lta bu'i mnyam bzhag khyad chos bzhi ldan de nyams su len pa'i lag len ni/ mnyam bzhag tu mi sgom rjes shes su ma yengs par/ dwangs ma'i shes pa yul la ma 'dzag pa de mnyam bzhag gi gnad/ gang shar rang ngo shes pa rjes shes kyi gnad/ mnyam bzhag tu phung po lnga dang bral ba/ rjes shes su rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi snang ba dag pa'o// de'i 'jog lugs ni/ so ma/ lhug pa/ rang gdangs so// so ma ni so ma shor ba/ lhug pa ni 'bad rtsol med pa/ rang gdangs ni gnyen po dang bral ba'o// lnga pa dran pa brten tshul ni/ nges tshig ngo bo/ ming gi rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ nyams len dngos so// de la shes byed kyi lung drangs pa dang drug go /dang po ni/ gnas lugs kyi don dran pa'am gsal stong rjen pa dran pas na dran pa zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gnas lugs yul med du rang ngo shes pa de dran pa'i ngo bo yin/ gsum pa ni/ dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin/ ma yengs/ ma brjed pa rnams don gcig yin no// bzhi pa dran pa ni dbye ba la'ang rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na bdun te/ go ba'i dran pa tshad gdung can gyis chu skad thos pa lta bu/ nyams kyi dran pa mun khong du sgron me bteg pa lta bu/

myong ba'i dran pa skyu ru zos pa'i mis skyu ru mthong ba lta bu/ thos pa'i dran pa dbul po'i mis sbyin pa'i gtam thos pa lta bu/ bsam pa'i dran pa 'dod chags can gyis mdzes ma yid la byed pa lta bu/ sgom pa'i dran pa bu gcig shi ba'i ma ltar 'bral med yid la byed pa lta bu/ rtog pa'i dran pa sngon 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu'o// ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis/ rtsol bcas kyi dran pa/ rtsol med kyi dran pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ gzung 'dzin gyi dran pa spyang khyis ri dwags ded pa lta bu/ bzung dran gyi dran pa ri dwags kyis smig rgyu snyeg pa lta bu/ skyes grol gyi dran pa rgya mtsho las rlabs g.yos tshe chu bur rang byung rang thim du 'gro ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa rtsol med kyi dran pa la gsum ste/ stong nyid kyi dran pa gser gling du skyes pa'i mi ma yin pa'i mi gcig gser gling du rtol ba lta bu/ blo 'das kyi dran pa mun gling du nyi zla shar ba lta bu'o/ lnga pa nyams len dngos la/ sems thog tu gnas na gnas mkhan gyi rang zhal blta/ gsal stong rjen pa 'char bas chos nyid rgyal sa zin/ sgo lnga'i yul du snang na snang mkhan gyi rang zhal blta/ a 'thas kyi snang ba stong pa'i rang gzugs su 'char/ 'phro na 'phro mkhan gyi rang zhal blta/ 'phro ba yul med du 'char bas gnyis 'dzin gyi mkhan po 'jig dang po rnam rtog la skyon du blta/ bar du rnam rtog grogs su khyer/ tha ma rnam rtog rgyan du 'char ro// yang na dang po gang shar gyi ngo bo la blta/ bar du sgom med kyi ngang la yengs med du skyongs/ tha mar gang shar gyi snang ba yul med du 'char ba'o// de yang dran pa brten tshul mthar thug pa cig yin no// drug pa shes byed kyi lung dgod pa ni/ sam bhu tra las// gzugs rnam sna tshogs mthong ba dang*// sgra rnam sna tshogs nyan pa dang*// las rnams thams cad byed pa ni// sems ni gzhan du mi 'phro bas// de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor la// rnal 'byor rgyun du skye bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/

mdo dkon mchog sprin las/ dran pa rin po che ni sangs rgyas kyi nor/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod/ sangs rgyas kyi gter zhes dang*/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas na/ sangs rgyas gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen pos/ bram zes skud pa 'khel ba bzhin// hrim gyis sgrim la lhod kyis klod// sems kyi bzhag thabs cig de na 'dug /ces dang*/ de nyid las/ skye la dbang po ltos shig dang*/ ngas ni de las ma rtogs so// rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ de las gzhan zhig sus kyang shes mi 'gyur// ces dang*/ yang de nyid las/ 'jur pos bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// klod na grol bar the tshom med// de nyid las/ mig ni mi btsum sgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor la// gnas dang gnas mal med pa'i gnas nyid du// chags dang chags pa med pa'i sems kyis ni// don dam pa yi sems ni bsgom par bya// zhes dang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ gang yang mi rtog cir yang mi sems par// bcas bcos med cing rang bzhin lhug par zhog /'di ni pha rol phyin mchog gnyis med lam// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis gshigs shul yin// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ gshegs shing grol ba med pa'i sems nyid las// don yengs med dran pa'i bya ra ba// blo sgom du med pa'i ngang la ni// yul yul can gnyis kyi rtsis gdab bral// 'di phyag chen sgom gyi skyong tshul yin// zhes dang*/ mgon po ri khrod pas/ e ma ho/ ltos shig ltos shig ma blta zhig /nga mthong pas ni grol 'gyur te// nga mthong pas ni 'chings bar 'gyur// ngas ma mthong bas grol 'gyur bas// nga ma mthong bas 'chings bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ lta ba slar log gzings las bya 'phur 'dra// sgom pa slar log ri dwags khyi dang 'dra// spyod pa slar log byis pa bu chung 'dra// 'bras bu slar log zhing pa'i so nam 'dra/

dang po sems nyid rang ngo shes pa gces// zhes dang*/ rje btsun tai lo pas/ kyai ho 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das blo yis dpyod yul min// tai lo ngas ni ci yang bstan rgyu med// rang gis rang nyid mtshon te shes par byos// mi mno mi bsam mi brtag mi dpyad cing*// mi bsgom mi sems rang mal rnal du bzhag /dmigs pa yid la mi byed cing*// dran pa rdul tsam med pa yi// sems nyid rang byung rang gsal la// nga yis ci yang bstan du med// ces dang*/ dpal nā ro pas/ phyi snang ba yul gyi shes pa 'di// nang rig pa sems su kho thag chod// sems nyid skye med spros dang bral// da ni su la yang dri ba mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ rje btsun mar pas/ sems stong pa nyid la spar 'dzin byas// don gnyug ma gshis kyi ngo bo mthong*// sku gsum ma dang dngos su mjal// mi kho bos sgro 'dogs de nas chod// zhes dang*/ rje btsun mi las/ yid la mi byed snying po'i don// skad gcig ma yengs bsgom du med// nga nam mkha'i mtshan nyid blta ba de// mi la rnal 'byor mi zer ram// zhes dang*/ dwags po rin po ches/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi rgyun lam 'di// ma yengs dran pas rgyun du skyong*// zhes dang*/ rin po che 2rmogs rtse bas/ gdams ngag gi rgyal po dran pa ru 'dug pas// ma yengs rgyun du skyong ba zhig byung na// nyams dang rtogs pa gong ma zhig ma skyes na// bla ma'i nga rang gi len pa yin no// zhes dang*/ 'gro mgon rgya ras pas/ dran pas ma zin go ba yis// sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gyur bar dka'// zhes dang*/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pas/ mos gus zhen log mgo dang rkang*// ma yengs mi bsgom gnad du che// zhes dang*/ yang dgon chos rjes/ de ltar dus rnams thams cad du// nya rta bu shi'i 'o ma ltar// 'bral med yengs med brjed med du// rgyun chad med par btsal bar bya// zhes dang*/

'ba' ra bas gsung las/ sems nyid ma bcos rang sar bzhag pa la// ma yengs tsam las ci yang bsgom du med// bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis 'dzin blos bsgom yin// 'phro zhing rgod na rnam rtog rang zhal blta// bying zhing rmugs na rig pa dpa' rtsal bskyed// thun tshugs dran pas gso ba man ngag yin// zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa 'di la/ bsgom rgyu 'di yin mi bdog gis dang*// tha mal shes pa rang sar zhog dang*// bzhag par mi sdod 'phro ba'i tshe na// 'phro mkhan ngo bo cer gyis zungs dang*// rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag nas// rtog pas gnyug ma'i gsal 'debs byed do// zhes dang*/ tha mal gyi shes pa so ma la// sgom 'dris byed pa ma gtogs pas// sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol bas// rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs pa bla ma'i drin// zhes dang*/ grub thob gtsang smyon gyis/ so so skye bo'i ye shes rang gis bcings// rnal 'byor pa la dug lnga rgyan du shar// bsgom par 'dod tshe sgom mkhan sgom gyis sgrib// sgom med rtogs tshe thams cad sgom du 'char// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// drug pa gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi rnam gzhag ni/ rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du gzhi lam 'bras gsum gcig sgrigs dang zer na/ sems gzo med du gnas pa de la gzhi phyag rgya chen po zer/ sna tshogs su 'phro ba de la lam phyag rgya chen po zer/ 'phro ba rang ngo ma shes pa de la ma dag pa'i lam/ de rang ngo shes nas gsal stong rjen par gtan la phebs pa de la 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po zer ro// yang cig sgrigs dang zer na/ gzhi skye med gcig la zer te mnyam bzhag gis gtan la phebs/ lam 'gags med cig la zer te rjes thob kyis gtan la 'bebs/ 'bras bu brjod bral cig la zer te zung 'jug gis gtan la 'bebs so// yang rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du lta sgom spyod 'bras cig sgrigs dang zer na/

lta ba yid la mi byed pa gcig la zer// sgom pa ma yengs dran pa gcig la zer// spyod pa shugs 'byung 'gags med cig la zer// 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur cig la zer// yang gcig sgrigs dang zer na/ lta ba mtha' gnyis dang bral ba gcig la zer// sgom pa gzung 'dzin dang bral ba gcig la zer// spyod pa dgag bsgrub dang bral ba gcig la zer// 'bras bu re dogs dang bral ba gcig la zer ro// bdun pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa ni/ e ma ho/ grub thob rgyal po'i gsung gi khrid las byung*// shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum du ni// ma shor skye lugs gsum gyis mtshams sbyar nas// rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa skye bar nges// shor sa bzhi ni/ stong nyid gshis la shor ba/ stong nyid lam du shor ba/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba'o// de la'ang*/ ye shor dang 'phral shor gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ go bar shor ba yin/ gnyis pa/ lag len nyams myong shor pa yin no// ye shor bzhi yi dang po gshis la shor ba ni/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa gnyis med kyi 'dug lugs ma go bar/ stong pa bya ba med pa'am/ ma grub pa gcig la blo rtse gtad nas stong par sbyangs nas ci yang ma grub pa la gshis su byed pa ni/ stong nyid gshis la shor ba yin no// lam du shor ba ni rgyu 'bras dbyer med kyi don ma go bar da lta stong nyid lam du byas nas bsgoms pas/ des 'bras bu sku gsum thob par 'dod pa ni lam du shor ba yin no// gnyen por shor ba ni spang bya rang gi dus su stong nyid du gnas pa la/ spang bya kho rang gi gnyen por kho rang shar bar ma go nas/ nyon mongs spang bar 'dod pa ni gnyen por shor ba yin no// rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni thabs shes zung 'jug zab rgyas dbyer med kyi don ma go bar/ sbyin pa'am bsngo ba lta bu gcig la sngon du 'khor gsum dmigs bcas su byas/

phyis su dmigs med kyis rgyas 'debs pa ni/ gong ma thabs rkyang pa/ 'og ma shes rab rkyang pa ste bden gnyis lam du mi slong zhing*/ don gnyis mngon du mi 'gyur bas so// 'phral shor bzhi ni/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa de yang bla ma'i gdams ngag dang*/ rang nyid shes rab chen po'i nyer len gyis don spyi ji lta ba bzhin go nas gzhan la smra shes kyang*/ pha ki na yod pa gcig gtan la 'bebs par song nas/ rig thog tu ngo ma 'phrod cing thug rag re ba ni gshis la shor ba yin/ rtog pa nyag nyog cig skyes pa'i dus su 'dzin med du thag ma chod par/ de las lhag pa gcig re nas sgom gyi lhan pa btab cing bsgom la 'jog pa ni lam du shor ba yin/ rnam rtog 'gyu ba'i dus su yang rang ngo ma shes par dran pas bkug cing bsgom la 'jog pa ni gnyen por shor ba yin no// rgyas 'debs su shor la ba gnyis te/ sgom mgo rkang ma tshang bar bdag po ma byung bar shor te/ dang po sgom dga' ba gcig skyes kyang phyis yid yul du dran tsam las med par/ de la phyir snyag gi yid brtan byas nas dmigs med yin mi rtog yin snyam du gsal 'debs pa'o// blo chung rgyas 'debs su shor ba ni mnyam rjes ro gcig tu ngo ma 'phrod cing rjes shes lam du ma slong pas/ a pa ci nas yengs 'dug pas/ da bsgom dgos snyam pas rnam rtog gi bre kha sgom gyis bcad pa'o// gol sa gsum ni/ bde ba la zhen pa yod/ gsal ba la 'dzin pa yod/ mi rtog pa la blos byas yod/ de gsum du zhen na khams gsum du gol/ zhen 'dzin med kyang gnas lugs kyi rang zhal ma mthong na nyan rang gi sa la gol lo// ma shor ba bzhi ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i don phyin ci ma log par go zhing*/ rang mtshan gyi rnam pa ma 'khrul bar rtog pas stong nyid gshis la mi 'chor/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa yin lugs su go bas bogs dbyung rgyu med par rgyu 'bras dbyer med kyi don go na stong nyid lam du mi 'chor ro// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i don go na stong nyid gnyen por mi 'chor/

mtshan ma'i dmigs bcas kyi dge ba tsam byas kyang*/ de'i gshis dmigs med las 'das pa med pas 'khor gsum rang gi ngo bos stong zhing*/ gang zag gis rgyas gdab mi dgos par chos nyid kyi rgyas ye gdabs su shes pas rgyas 'debs su mi shor ro// skye lugs gsum gyi cig car pa'i skye lugs ni/ rong gting mo'i nyi ma dang 'dra zhing nyi rgan de shar ma thag tu mun pa sangs ba sa rdo dros pa/ 'khyags pa zhu ba rnams dus cig car du 'ong ba ltar/ bla ma bcud ldan cig gi drung du slob ma snod ldan cig gis mos gus tshad med pa gcig gnad du bsnun pa'i tshe/ byin rlabs kyi 'pho ba don gyi tshigs rgyud du thob nas/ gnas pa nyams myong rtogs pa gsum sgom pa po med par cig car du shar nas skad cig la skye ba yin te/ dper na dwags po rin po che/ gling ras pa lta bu'o// rim gyis pa'i skye lugs ni/ gnam kha zhing can gyi nyi ma dang 'dra ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa rag tsam sangs 'dug kyang sa rdo mi dros shing 'khyags pa zhu mi nus pa ltar/ gnas pa nyams myong rtog pa gsum rim gyis nad nud skyes nas sems kyi rang zhal mthong tsam las/ 'phral du spang bya spang mi nus shing gnyen po la dbang ma thob pas sgom gnyug bsring dgos so// thod brgal pa'i skye lugs ni/ sprin bar gyi nyi ma dang 'dra ste/ sngon la rtog pa 'char yang mi brtan par mtho dman dang gsal 'grib che bas/ res a 'thas su yong*/ res rtogs pa rjen par yong ste tshe 'dir sgom yun thung ba'am/ le lo che bas mngon du ma gyur kyang de'i rtogs pa gsha' ma gcig bar dor 'char ba yin no// mtshams sbyor ba ni/ gnas 'gyu gnyis la dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom spel nas 'khor 'das dbyer med du mtshams sbyor ba yin no// rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa ni/ ā li kā li chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde chen po bzhi// gdul bya'i blo dang bstun nas gsungs pa kun// thams cad snying po'i don du bzhi yis bstan// yang dag don ni sus kyang mtshon du med// de nyid rtogs phyir bla ma mkhas la brten// zhes so// de'i don rje btsun mi la ras pas mgur bzhengs pa/

rje bla ma mchog gi zhabs la 'dud// sems dngos por 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rgyu// gsal la 'dzin med rang rig 'di// lhun grub yin par ngo shes na// rtse gcig gi mtha' ru phyin pa yin// zung 'jug zer zhing mtshan bcas bsgom// rgyu 'bras zer zhing log 'tsho bsgrub// rmongs pas kun 'byung bsgom pa las// rtse cig gi rnal 'byor kho la med// gsal la 'dzin med rang rig 'di// spros bral bde ba'i snying po can// ngo bo mkha' ltar dag tsa na// spros bral mtha' ru phyin pa yin// spros med zer zhing spros pa mang*// brjod med zer zhing tha snyad mang*// rmongs pas ngar 'dzin sgom pa las// spros bral rnal 'byor kho la med// snang stong gnyis med chos sku la// 'khor 'das gcig tu nyams su myong*// sangs rgyas sems can 'dres tsa na// ro gcig mtha' ru phyin pa yin// ro gcig zer zhing du mar smra// nyag gcig zer zhing thun du gcod// rmongs pas yid gnyis sgom pa la// ro gcig rnal 'byor kho la med// rnam rtog ye shes snying po can// lhun grub rgyu 'bras gnyis su med// sku gsum rang la tshang tsa na// sgom med mtha' ru phyin pa yin// sgom med zer zhing yid la byed// 'od gsal zer zhing gti mug bsgom// rmongs pas kha lta sgom pa las// sgom med rnal 'byor khong la med// ces pas dbang po cig car pa'i bzhi rim du gsungs so// dbang po rim gyis pa'i rgyud la rnal 'byor bzhi skye tshul ni/ dwags po rin po che'i zhal gdams las/ lhan gcig gi skyes pa'i ye shes de// btsir gyis bzung na gnyug ma yin// lhod kyis klod na spros dang bral/ lhan cig rtogs na ro gcig ste// rnam rtog spang du mi 'dod de// rtog med bsgrub tu mi 'dod btub// sgom bral 'di sems kyi ngo bor 'dod// ces dang*/ rtse gcig sems kyi rang bzhin shes pa yin// spros bral stong pa'i rang bzhin shes pa yin// ro gcig snang ba'i rang bzhin shes pa yin// sgom med de ni nga la ya cha med// ces dang*/

yang rtse gcig nal gyi bu dang 'dra// skyes pa mang ste khas len nyung*// spros bral spyi rta sga can 'dra// kha 'dzin mang ste don gnyer nyung*// ro gcig gter gyi kha byang 'dra// gleng mi mang ste thon pa dkon// sgom med rgyal po'i gdan sa 'dra// smon pa mang ston thob pa dkon// zhes gsungs so// de dag gi dgongs 'grel du dpal phag mo gru pas rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su bzhed de/ rtse gcig chung ngus bde gsal gyi ngo bo mthong*/ 'bring pos ting nge 'dzin la rang dbang thob/ chen pos nyams kyi khor yug ma/ spros bral chung ngus skye 'gags med par rtogs/ 'bring pos rtsa ba dang bral bar rtogs/ chen pos phyi nang gi chos la sgro 'dogs chod/ ro gcig chung ngus 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres/ 'bring pos gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chod/ chen pos chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du zhi ba'o// sgom med chung ngu bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral/ 'bring po lhun grub kyi rang sa zin/ chen po lam dang 'bras bu 'od gsal gcig tu 'dres so// zhes gsungs so// rnal 'byor bzhi'i myong ba skye tshul/ rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du sbyor tshul ni/ dwags po sgom chung gyi zhal gdams las/ ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ ngang la gnas pa rtse cig yin// sgro 'dogs chod pa spros bral yin// spang blang med pa ro gcig yin// myong ba dag pa sgom med yin// mnyam bzhag gi rtogs pa bzhi ni/ rtse gcig gi dus su ngo bo rtogs// spros bral gyi dus su rang bzhin rtogs// ro gcig gi dus su mtshan nyid rtogs// sgom med du rtogs pa'i khor yug ma// rtogs pa'i 'khor sa bzhi ni/ rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'khyams// spros bral med pa'i stong rdzis khyer// ro gcig rgya mtsho'i 'dres pas rba la g.yengs// sgom med nyi zla sprin gyis bsgribs// rjes kyi skye tshul bzhi ni/

rtse gcig gi rjes shes a 'thas su skye// spros bral gyi rjes shes sgyu ma ru skye// ro gcig gi rjes shes stong pa ru skye// sgom med kyi rjes shes snying rje ru skye// rjes shes kyi dri ma bzhi ni/ rtse gcig ngos 'dzin ma shes kyi dri ma/ spros bral ngo ma shes kyi dri ma/ ro gcig nyams kyi dri ma/ sgom med shes bya'i dri ma'o// rjes shes kyi dag tshul bzhi ni/ rtse gcig la bral ba yod la thob pa med/ spros bral la bral thob gnyis ka yod/ ro gcig la bral ba med la thob pa yod/ sgom med la bral thob gnyis ka med do// mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams bzhi ni/ rtse gcig gi mnyam rjes btags pa ba/ spros bral gyi mnyam rjes mtshan nyid pa/ ro gcig gi mnyam rjes dran pa/ sgom med kyi mnyam bzhag de kho na'o// nyams rtogs kyi shan 'byed bzhi ni/ rtse gcig nyams kho na/ spros bral nyams rtogs shag gis 'byed/ ro gcig gi nyams rtogs zung 'jug sgom med kyi rtogs pa kho na'o// rgyu 'bras kyi skye tshul bzhi ni/ rtse gcig la a 'thas kyi rgyu 'bras/ spros bral du sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras/ ro gcig nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras/ sgom med la gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rgyu 'bras so// skyong thabs bzhi ni/ rtse gcig gi skyong thabs/ bla ma'i mos gus kyi sa la dor te dben gnas ri khrod 'grim/ spros bral gyi skyong thabs/ tshogs spyod kyis la dor te yul so so'i bdud rtsi'i ro myong*/ ro gcig gi skyong thabs/ mtshan ldan phyag rgyas la dor te dga' bzhi'i rang zhal mjal/ sgom med kyi skyong thabs/ snying rjes la dor te 'gro ba'i khol po byed do// de dag gi sdom ni/ ting 'dzin rtog pa'i 'khor sa dang*// rjes shes dri ma bral thob ste// mnyam rjes nyams rtogs rgyu 'bras skye// skyong thabs 'bras bu bcu gcig go

/rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal gdams/ dpal stag lung thang pa'i bzhed pa/ grub thob gtsang pa smyon pa'i gsung rgyun ni 'di lta ste/ de la rtogs lugs gsum ni/ spros bral gyis rang bzhin skye med du rtogs/ ro gcig gis ngo bo zung 'brel du rtogs/ sgom med kyis mtshan nyid gnyis med du rtogs so// bral lugs gsum ni/ spros bral du 'khor ba'i rtog rgya dang bral/ ro gcig rnam smin lus rgya dang bral/ sgom med bag chags kyi snang rgya dang bral/ mngon gyur gsum ni/ spros bral du rag pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ ro gcig tu phra ba'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ sgom med du dag pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur ro// dag lugs gsum ni/ spros bral gyi dus su nyon sgrib dag ro gcig gi dus su las sgrib dag sgom med kyi dus su shes sgrib dag rtogs lugs gsum ni/ spros bral gyi dus su chos skur rtogs/ ro gcig gi dus su 'ja' lus kyi skur rtogs/ sgom med kyi dus su sku gsum mngon du rtogs/ lus gsum ni/ spros bral rmi lam gyi lus// ro gcig ting nge 'dzin gyi lus/ sgom med phrin las kyi lus so// 'char lugs gsum ni/ spros bral snang med shes rab dang po 'char/ ro gcig tu bar pa 'char/ sgom med du gsum pa 'char ro// ldan lugs gsum ni/ spros bral rtsol bcas kyi snying rjer ldan/ ro gcig rtsol med kyi snying rjer ldan/ sgom med du dmigs med kyi snying rjer ldan/ dus gsum ni/ spros bral dus su rnam rtog chos skur 'char/ ro gcig dus su sna tshogs sgom du 'char/ sgom med dus su bya rtsol thams cad dbyings su thim ste ye shes rang la grub pa'o// de dag gi sdom ni/ rtogs bral mngon gyur dag pa dang*// rtogs lugs 'char lugs ldan dus so// zhes so// rnal 'byor bzhi po re re la'ang 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/

ngo bo mthong ma mthong*/ rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar/ yon tan rgyud la skyes ma skyes/ kun rdzob rang byan tshud ma tshud/ gzugs sku'i sa bon theb ma theb/ phra zhib drug gi sgom nas nyams myong gi spu ris rig thog tu 'byed dgos pas/ de dag gi sdom ni/ ngo mthong rtsal rdzogs rtog sgom shar// yon skyes byan tshud sa bon thebs// ces gsungs so// rje rgod tshang pa'i zhal nas/ yul med kyi rig pa rang gsal 'di// goms nas mngon du gyur pa la// rnal 'byor bzhi ru bstan nas gda'// don ni ye shes zang thal lo// zhes gsungs so// grub thob gtsang smyon pa'i zhal nas/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad thol skyes kyi rig pa skad cig ma'i steng du rdzogs shing tshang la/ de la gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyis rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngo bor gnas te/ tshogs drug gi snang ba cig shar tsa na de'i ngang la mi g.yo bas na rtse gcig rtse gcig gi dus na mtshan 'dzin gyi spros pa dang bral bas na spros bral/ spros pa dang bral ba'i dus na 'khor 'das mnyam du ro gcig pas na ro gcig ro gcig pa'i dus na blo las 'das pas na sgom med do// yang thol skyes kyi rnam rtog so ma gra ma chag zur ma nyams pa rtse gcig de rang ngo shes pa spros bral/ gsal stong zung 'jug tu ro myong ba ro gcig blo 'das chen por grol ba sgom med do// yang na mnyam pa rtse gcig lhug pa spros bral/ rang gdangs ro gcig brjod bral sgom med do// yang na skye med las mi 'da' ba rtse gcig 'gags med du 'char ba spros bral/ gnyis med du myong ba ro gcig myong med du grol ba sgom med do// yang na rtse gcig gi dus su rnam rtog 'gags shing bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum nyams su myong ba de nyams/ myong mkhan ma grub par shes pa de rtog pa/ spros bral gyi dus su spros bral ngo shes shing mtho dman sna tshogs su snang ba de nyams/

de thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du shes pa rtog pa/ ro gcig dus su rkyen bzang ngan thams cad rtog pa'i gsal mdangs nges shes su 'char ba nyams/ sems nyid rtsa bral du rtogs pa'i ngo bo de dang*/ sems byung dran pa rnams gnyis med ro gcig tu rtogs pas na rtog pa/ sgom med kyi dus su nyams rtog dbyer med blo 'das chen po de sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa thar thug pa'o// mdor na blos byas thams cad nyams yin no// blo 'das thams cad rtog pa yin no// tai lo pa chen pos// blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi rtogs// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rnyed// blo 'das byar med don de rtogs 'dod na// rigs pa rtsad chod sems nyid gcer bur zhog /ces dang*/ grub thob gling ras pas/ rje yi zhal nas gnyug ma'i don/ sgoms shig gsungs nas bsgoms lags pas/ bsgom bya sgom byed gtor nas thal/ thun mtshams bzung rgyu mi gda' 'o// zhes dang*/ rgyal dbang chos rjes/ mi la las stong nyid stong nyid zer// stong mkhan stong rgyu ma grub pa// byas shing bcos pa ma lags te// gshis rang bzhin gyis stong pa yin par gda'// zhes dang*/ gtsang smyon chos rjes/ sprul pa dri za'i grong khyer du// sgyu ma glog gi rol rtsed byas// rmi lam skyes bu a thang chad// skye bo myos gyur sangs pa bzhin// ye nas blo las 'das par 'dra// zhes gsungs so// rnal 'byor bzhi po re re'i thog tu yang bzhir bzhir tshang lugs ni/ grub thob gtsang pa he ru kas/ phra rag gi rtog pa zhi nas gsal stong gi ngang la gnas pa de rtse gcig gi rtse gcig gnas pa'i ngo bo la mtshan 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa de rtse gcig gi spros bral/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum spang blang med par ro gcig tu myong ba de rtse gcig gi ro cig myong mkhan gyi shes pa ma grub par shes pa de rtse gcig gi sgom med do// rnam rtog gang shar skye med kyi ngang du 'gro ba spros bral gyi rtse gcig

tshogs drug gi yul snang mtshan mar ma grub cing de la 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa de spros bral gyi spros bral/ rnam rtog gang shar la spang blang med pa de spros bral gyi ro gcig stong nyid kyi myong ba dag pa spros bral gyi sgom med yin no// de la du ma'i chos thams cad rtogs pa gcig gi ngang du 'dzin med du gnas pa ro gcig gi rtse gcig snang sems tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod pa ro gcig gi spros bral/ snang stong gnyis la dgag sgrub bam spang blang lus sems snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres pa ro gcig gi rtse gcig bsgom bya sgom byed kyi myong ba dag pa ro gcig gi sgom med do// de yang ji lta ba'i ngang las mi 'da' bar gnas pa sgom med kyi rtse gcig shes bya ji snyed kyi chos thams cad la sgro 'dogs chod pa sgom med kyi spros bral/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don la spang blang med pa sgom med kyi ro gcig ye shes rang grib kyi myong ba dag pa sgom med kyi sgom med do// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i blo khyad dang blo gros yod tsa na gcig pur bsdad kyang 'gro don nus shing mang po'i gseb tu'ang 'gro don 'ong ngo*// spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang rung 'gro don lam las ma 'das pa yin no// de ltar ma yin pa'i rang re'i zhe 'dod rkyang pa de khar bcangs snying rje phyogs ris can gyis phan 'dogs pa ni/ khra dang spyang khyi la yang yod pa yin no// 'o skol 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu 'di cis lan snyam na/ dpal phag mo gru pa de nyid/ dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i spyan sngar phyin nas/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di gang gis lan zhus pas/ bla ma wa la'i zhal nas/ bdag tu 'dzin pas lan gsungs/ la las ni ma rig pas lan gsungs/ la las ni tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis ma sbyang pas lan gsungs/ bla ma sa skya pa'i zhal nas/

rlung sems dbu mar ma tshud pas lan gsungs/ dwags po rin po che'i spyan ngar phyin par/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo ma shes pas lan gsungs/ de la thugs shin tu mthun par byung ste/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid zhus pas/ ngo sprod kyi skabs su rnam par shes pa 'di lhan cig skyes pa'i chos kyi sku yin/ phyi rol gyi snang ba dkar dmar 'di chos sku'i rang 'od dam rol pa yin no gsungs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi sgro 'dogs ma lus pa chod do// yang dgon pa'i zhal nas/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di ltar du shar yang*/ nang sems kyi byed las phyir shar ba yin/ sems las log pa'i snang ba gcig phyi rol du grub pa med/ dngos po ltar snang yang rang gi shes pa 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin/ dper na mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por snang yang de mig gi skyon ma gtogs dung ser por song ba med/ de bzhin du zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba yod na phyi rol du snang ba thams cad dgrar snang ba 'char ba yin/ nang du byams pa'i sems 'byong na phyi rol gyi sems can thams cad pha mar mthong bar 'gyur ro// nang du bskyed rim la brtan pa thob na snang ba thams cad lha dang lha mor mthong*/ nang du phyag rgya chen po'i rtog pa mnyam rjes med par 'byong na/ phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad chos sku bde ba chen po'i rol par 'char ba yin te/ dus gsum mkhyen pas/ zhe sdang ldan pa'i sgom chen la// snang ba thams cad dgra bor mthong*// byams pa sgom pa'i sgom chen la// dgra gnyen med par pha mar mthong*// bskyed rim brtan pa'i sgom chen la// snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas mthong*// 'od gsal sgom pa'i sgom chen la// phyi nang med par chos skur mthong*// phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin// nang gi byed pa phyi ru shar// zhes gsungs so// yang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi ngos 'dzin ni/ gtsang smyon chos rje'i zhal nas/

sems dang rnam shes chos sku gsum// dang po lhan cig skyes pa de// gdams pas rgyud la 'byor ba la// lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes brjod do// zhes pa'i don ni sems nyid rang ngo spros pa dang bral ba'i dus na gnyis 'dzin mkha' ltar dag gnyis snang gi spun thag chad/ 'khor 'das kyi blos reg tu ma btub pa la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i chos kyi sku zhes ming tsam brda tsam du btags/ 'khrul snang sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di gnas lugs chos sku spros bral gyi ngo bo ma sbas/ ma nor ma bral bar rjen ne 'dug pa 'di la rnam rtog lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku zhes ming du btags/ snang ba ma 'gags la 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa'i snang stong yul med du rjen ne ba 'di la snang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku zhes ming du btags/ ngos bzung med la gsal snang ma 'gags pa'i shes pa yul med du rjen ne ba 'di la/ stong pa lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku zhes zer ba dang*/ gnas lugs chos sku spros bral zhes ming du btags pa tsam/ sems rnam rtog chos sku gsum sangs rgyas kyis kyang so sor 'byed ma shes pa la lhan cig skyes pa zhes brda tsam btags pa lags/ snang ba dang stong pa zung 'jug gsum ye gdod ma nas bral ma myong ba'i rang mtshan rig nas rang ngo shes pa la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes zer ba lags/ yang 'khrul pa'i dogs gcod bsal ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ gzhi'i dus na 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi 'dzin pa blo las 'das/ skyon yon gnyis ka nas dag pa yin pas 'khrul pa zhes bya ba'i ming yang med do// zhes dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gis/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// zhes dang*/ sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku// zhes so// drin can thub pa'i dbang pos/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ zhes gsungs pa yang gzhi la dgongs pa yin te/

dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba// zhes pa/ 'gags med kyi rtsal gyi skabs su rang ngo rang gis ma shes pa dgongs nas 'khrul pa zhes ming btags pa lags/ mchog gi sprul sku dga' rab rdo rjes/ kun gzhi rnam par dag pa'i dbyings 'di na// glo bur 'khrul ba'i dri mas ma gos shing*// phra ba tsam yang rab tu dag pa yi// chos sku mtha' ru phyin pa thob par shog /ces pa smon lam gtsug rgyan nor bu nas gsungs so// mnga' bdag mai tri'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gzhi rtsa/ kun gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po 'di/ ye nas stong zhing bdag med pa/ 'od gsal ba/ 'dus ma byas pa/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa chos sku lhun grub tu bzhugs pa la/ 'gags med lam gyi skabs su rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas/ sems nyid sgyu ma tsam zhig 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras sgyu ma tsam la longs spyod cing 'khor ba na 'khor bas 'khrul pa'i skabs su zhugs pa yin no// de las thar par byed pa la sems kyi gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin rtogs dgos pa yin gsungs so// bzhi pa 'khrul pa bzo ba theg dman gyi grub mtha' la zhen cing*/ nges don yin lugs kyi rang 'tshang ma rig pa yin pa dgongs zhu/ lam gyi ngo bol 'khrul ba med/ yod na gzhi lam gnyis su song ste/ gnyis su med/ gnyis su byar med/ so so ma yin tha mi dad do// ma shes rmongs pa'i snang ngor 'khrul ba zer ba'i ming 'di 'gags med lam gyi skabs su byung ba lags/ 'bras bu la dpyad du med/ gzhi 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi dogs dpyod zer ba lags so// yang zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi skabs su phra rag rtog pa thams cad zhi nas/ rang sems bzo med gshis thog tu sa le seng nge lam me/ rtog pa'i snang ba med par yun du gnas pa de la zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin zer ba lags/ rtog pa 'gags pas phyi ma ma skye pa'i bar na/ da ltar gyi shes pa skad cig ma'am/

sems rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo kho rang gis kho rang yul med du rang ngo shes shing*/ rtog med du sgro 'dogs chod pas gsal la ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa rjen ne/ lhag gis mthong ba de la lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin zer ba lags/ snang ba gang shar gyi thog tu snang la 'dzin pa med par yul med du rang 'tshang rig ste gu yangs kyi gting thob pa la/ zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting nge 'dzin zer ba lags so// snang srid phyag rgya chen po la kha yan 'gyad tshul ni/ yang dgon chos rjes gsungs pa/ snang srid phyag rgya chen po spyir snang ye shes kyi 'khor lo ngan pa'i spang bya rdul tsam yang mi rnyed pa/ rin po che gser gyi gling du phyin pa lta bu'i gdams pa rang shar rang grol/ gcig shes kun grol ni gnad shes na chos skur 'char ba yin gsungs pa'i don de gtan la 'bebs pa la/ rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa la/ sems kyi ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa la/ rnam pa cir yang 'char ba/ yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa/ gsal stong rig pa'i snying po can du thag chod dgos gsungs pa las/ tshad ma 'di la rgyab brten bcas/ lta ba'i rtsa ba rang sems dngos med yin/ sems la sems kyi rgyun du yengs med blta ste/ go yul don spyis ma bslad pa'i nyams myong tshad mas rig thog tu gtan la dbab pa'i dus gcig na/ sems kyi ngo bo gang du yang ma grub pa'i don sems la sems kyis yengs med du bltas pa'i tshe bltas pas ma mthong*/ btsal bas ma rnyed/ bzung nas ma zin/ bzhag sar mi sdod/ kha dog dbyibs sogs dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pas/ skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba/ rang bzhin gyis stong pas 'di yin gyi ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba de yin/ 'di la shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs/ skye med/ stong pa/ chos sku/ don dam gyi gnas lugs zhes pa'i ming btags pa yin/ sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku de rang rkyen nges shes kyi shes pa gtad med kyis bskul nas tshogs drug yul snang sna tshogs shar ba la dgongs nas/

snang ba thams cad rang snang yin/ 'gyu ba thams cad stong 'gyu ru nges dgos/ snang thog tu 'dzin pa zhugs pa'i rnam rtog thams cad chos sku 'gags med du shar ba'i rang rtsal yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rnam rtog thams cad chos sku ru thag chod dgos te/ rje btsun gling ras kyi zhal nas/ shin tu dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho las// chu bur byung zhing thim gyur pa// rnam rtog chos skur ngo sprod pa'i// slob dpon gcig lags te go lags sam// zhes gsungs so// de ltar rgyud sde bzhi yi snying po'i don// khyad par 'khor lo bde mchog bcud phyungs nas// rim gnyis las byung maṇḍal phyag rgya che// rdo rje 'chang nas tai lo nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// nyams rtogs khyad par skye ba'i lam zab mo// skal ldan gcig car grol ba'i man ngag gnad// phyag chen yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid 'di ni// phyogs las rnam rgyal mkhas grub paṇḍi ta// 'jigs bral dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos// legs sbyar de yi padmo la btug pa'i// rnying ma rab 'byams sangs rgyas gsang ba ngas// skal ldan rnams la phan pa'i don slad du// mjug bsdus 'di yang bdag gis legs par byas// mtha' yas sems can ma lus thams cad rnams// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa thob shog// /
